description:
- Full time 35 hours per week, Monday-Friday

title: Brand and Marketing Manager
description:
Are you a creative, commercially minded marketer who knows how to build a brilliant brand, bring it to life through compelling content and turn great ideas into genuine business opportunities? Someone who's just as comfortable shaping strategy as getting stuck into creating content, delivering campaigns and generating leads? If so, this could be a fantastic opportunity to build a marketing function from scratch and play a key role in the growth of an ambitious business.

The Company

Our client is a hugely successful and growing food business supplying customers across the UK. If you haven't eaten one of their products in the last couple of weeks, there's a pretty good chance the person next to you has.

With ambitious expansion plans, exciting product innovation and growing retail ambitions, the business is looking to build a nationally recognised brand. New partnerships and collaborations are opening up, making this a fantastic time to join and shape its marketing function from the ground up.

The Role - Brand and Marketing Manager

This is a fantastic opportunity for a creative, commercially minded marketer who wants to do more than deliver someone else's marketing plan.

Working with the leadership team, you'll shape the brand and marketing strategy, create compelling content and deliver targeted campaigns that generate enquiries from national foodservice operators, wholesalers, restaurant groups and retailers. You'll also help bring product launches, chef demonstrations and new collaborations to life, turning ideas into qualified sales opportunities.

It's a rare combination of strategic influence and hands-on creativity, with a genuine voice in the company's growth and the opportunity to build something that has your fingerprints all over it.

Key Responsibilities - Brand and Marketing Manager
- Develop and deliver a marketing strategy that supports the company's ambitious growth plans.
- Take ownership of the brand, ensuring a consistent, compelling identity and tone of voice across all channels.
- Personally create engaging content across social media, digital platforms and marketing materials, including photography, filming, editing and writing.
- Build the company's social media presence, particularly across LinkedIn and Instagram, developing audiences and encouraging meaningful engagement.
- Work closely with the leadership, product development and chef teams to organise product launches, coordinate chef demonstrations and bring new products and innovations to market.
- Help shape and promote exciting new partnerships and collaborations, identifying opportunities to extend the brand's reach.
- Develop targeted campaigns that generate qualified enquiries and sales opportunities from national foodservice operators, wholesalers, restaurant groups and retailers.
- Plan and deliver email marketing campaigns, using CRM data to segment audiences, nurture relationships and support customer engagement.
- Use CRM systems to track campaign responses and enquiries, support timely sales follow-up and measure how marketing activity contributes to qualified opportunities.
- Produce engaging sales and marketing materials, from product presentations and email campaigns to customer stories and website content.
- Establish marketing processes, manage budgets and measure performance, continually refining activity to deliver the best results.

About You - Brand and Marketing Manager

We're looking for someone who can see the bigger picture but is equally happy picking up a camera, writing a great piece of copy or getting stuck into a campaign.

You'll be comfortable developing ideas, challenging thinking and turning a relatively blank marketing canvas into something rather impressive.

Ideally, you'll bring:
- Broad marketing experience, with the confidence to take ownership of both strategy and delivery.
- A genuine flair for content creation, storytelling and brand development.
- Strong writing skills and an eye for engaging photography, video and visual content, with the ability to produce and edit content personally rather than relying entirely on agencies.
- Experience building social media audiences and creating campaigns that deliver meaningful engagement.
- Experience using CRM systems and delivering effective email marketing campaigns, with an understanding of audience segmentation and customer engagement.
- A commercial mindset and experience turning targeted marketing activity into relevant enquiries and qualified sales opportunities.
- The confidence to work closely with senior stakeholders, chefs and commercial teams, contributing to discussions around innovation, retail growth, partnerships and new opportunities.
- A proactive, resourceful approach, with the ability to establish processes and make things happen without needing a fully formed marketing department around you.

Experience within food, FMCG, hospitality or another product-led business would be advantageous, although we're equally interested in people from other sectors who can demonstrate the right combination of creativity, commercial thinking and initiative.

title: Communications and Engagement Manager
description:
Communications and Engagement Manager Future Projects

Location: Norwich, with occasional Norfolk-wide travel
Hours: 37 hours per week (subject to the Four Day Week scheme following 6 months in post)
Salary: £35,000 to £38,000 pa (depending on experience)
Leave: 25 days per annum plus Bank Holidays
Application Deadline: Monday 14th December 2026

Interviews: Week commencing Monday 21st December 2026
Reports to: Head of Funding, Partnerships and Impact

About the Role

Future Projects is a Norwich charity, founded in 2000, helping people in difficult situations build the skills, confidence and resilience to take control and transform their lives. We provide practical support across food and essentials, advice and guidance, health and wellbeing, employment, education and community connection.

As Communications and Engagement Manager, you will lead how Future Projects is seen, heard and understood. In this strategic role across the whole charity, you will strengthen our brand, voice and visibility, help Future Radio grow its profile, and make sure communities help shape our services and the story of our impact.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead the rollout of our brand, verbal identity and key messages, turning them into guidance, templates and training for staff.
- Develop and deliver a communications and marketing plan linked to the charity s strategy.
- Oversee website content, social media, newsletters, press, printed materials and campaigns.
- Work with the Future Radio team to promote the station and use radio, podcasts and digital content to support community voice.
- Develop community engagement and feedback approaches so people help shape our services and communications.
- Turn outcomes, data and case studies into impact stories that support fundraising and partnerships, with strict GDPR-compliant consent.

About You
- Strong experience in communications, marketing, media, engagement or brand.
- Excellent writing and editing skills for different audiences and channels.
- Experience developing communications plans, campaigns, content and brand assets.
- Strong understanding of digital communications, websites, social media and accessibility.
- Sound judgement around consent, GDPR, safeguarding and sensitive stories.
- Confident supporting and training colleagues, and building relationships with leaders, partners, funders and media.
- Desirable: charity or social impact sector experience, and an understanding of community media, radio, podcasting or video.

How to Apply
- Apply through this advert to receive an application form, along with the full job description.
- Complete the form in full, using the person specification and key deliverables to structure your answers. CVs are not accepted without a completed application form.

Additional Information
- Office and service-site working, with some flexibility around campaigns, events and launches.
- May line manage communications staff if such roles are created.
- Induction and training provided, including Health and Safety and Safeguarding.
- Appointment subject to pre-employment checks, including right to work, two references and an appropriate DBS check.
- Future Projects is an equal opportunities, Living Wage and Disability Confident employer.

title: CRM Executive

title: Senior Communications & Marketing Officer
description:
